message: Field "Post.body" has type Unsupported(...), which takes no native type, but has attribute "@db.Text". Prisma 7 refuses this schema too: "Attribute not known". Remove "@db.Text".

Field "Post.seenAt" has type "Unsupported", but @updatedAt is only allowed on a DateTime field. Prisma 7 refuses this schema too: "Fields that are marked with @updatedAt must be of type DateTime." Remove @updatedAt, or change the field's type to DateTime.
